agencies.head: Keep delivery moving between client conversations.
agencies.pain: The brief is incomplete. Feedback is scattered. Someone has to turn every conversation into the next task.
agencies.role: Organise incoming requests, retrieve project context, ask for missing details and prepare tasks and status updates.
agencies.impl: Less coordination around delivery. More attention on the work clients buy.
agencies.note: Scope, price and approval decisions stay with your team.
caps: The approved information becomes an organised task.

cards.t: Can we add a short social cut to the spring campaign? We need it before launch.
Which formats do you need for the social cut?

agencies.extra: For suitable agencies we can also discuss a managed agent service they offer to their own clients. That is a separate conversation, scoped and priced on its own. It is not part of the standard service and carries no promise of extra revenue.

property.head: Turn enquiries into an organised next step.
property.pain: Viewing requests, availability and property details sit in different places. Staff have to keep the conversation moving.
property.role: Collect enquiry details, retrieve approved property information, coordinate available viewing slots and update the record.
property.impl: Fewer conversations left waiting. Less back-and-forth for the team.
property.note: Applicant selection, referencing and tenancy decisions stay with your team.
caps: A viewing enquiry arrives by message.
The property record supplies approved facts.
A slot is selected in the conversation.
The enquiry record and confirmation update.

cards.t: Is the 2-bed on Mill Lane still available? Can I view it this week?

recruitment.head: Keep the process moving between interviews.
recruitment.pain: Availability, reminders and candidate updates require repeated coordination between several people.
recruitment.role: Collect availability, coordinate approved interview slots, prepare candidate updates and record scheduling activity.
recruitment.impl: Less diary coordination. More time for recruiter conversations.
recruitment.note: Shortlisting, ranking and hiring decisions stay with your people.
caps: Candidate and interviewer availability arrive separately.
A confirmation is prepared within permissions.

cards.t: I can do Tuesday 14:00 to 17:00, or Wednesday after 12:00.

wholesale.head: Answer the order question without the internal chase.
wholesale.pain: A customer needs stock or delivery information. Sales has to find the answer across records and other teams.
wholesale.role: Retrieve authorised stock and order information, gather missing order details and prepare a response grounded in the current records.
wholesale.impl: Less internal searching before a customer can get an answer.
wholesale.note: Delivery dates are only given once they are confirmed in the order record.
caps: “Can you supply this?” arrives by email.
The order record supplies confirmed delivery.
The reply is prepared with the relevant details.

cards.t: Can you supply 200 more of PX-40? And is order SO-2291 still arriving Wednesday?

manufacturing.head: Keep order updates from becoming a daily chase.
manufacturing.pain: Customer updates depend on production information, supplier responses and order records that do not arrive together.
manufacturing.role: Collect approved status information, follow up on missing updates, maintain the order record and prepare an exception summary.
manufacturing.impl: Clearer coordination around orders. Less time assembling the same update.
manufacturing.note: It does not control machinery or change production schedules.
caps: A customer asks for an update.
The order record shows a missing supplier confirmation.
The agreed follow-up goes to the supplier.
The records change. One exception goes to the manager.

cards.t: Where are we on order 4471? We need the housings by the 28th.
Please confirm the coating completion date for order 4471.

consultancies.head: Keep agreed actions moving after the meeting.
consultancies.pain: Decisions are recorded, but someone still has to organise the actions, find the documents and follow up.
consultancies.role: Use authorised meeting notes to prepare an action list, draft follow-up messages, organise relevant files and update the project record.
consultancies.impl: Less administration between the conversation and the work.
consultancies.note: Your consultants review every message before it goes to a client.
caps: The action record shows ownership and the next step.

cards.t: Steering call. Revised scope agreed. Jo to send options. Sam to share the Q3 data.
Thanks both. Actions, owners and dates are below. Q3 data is attached.

legal.head: Move intake forward with the information in place.
legal.pain: Initial enquiries arrive without the details and documents needed for the next conversation.
legal.role: Collect agreed intake information, request missing documents, organise the matter file and prepare a summary for the legal team.
legal.impl: Less intake chasing before the team can assess the matter.
legal.note: It gives no legal advice and makes no conflict-check decision. Your team reviews every intake.
caps: The intake checklist identifies missing documents.
Received files join the matter record.
An intake summary is ready for human review.

cards.t: A supplier has not paid three invoices. Can someone call me this week?
Please send the signed contract and the three invoices.

insurance.head: Bring the renewal information together.
insurance.pain: Renewal details and supporting documents need repeated collection before a broker can act.
insurance.role: Request agreed renewal information, organise documents, update the customer record and flag missing items for the broker.
insurance.impl: Less document chasing around the broker's work.
insurance.note: No policy recommendations, underwriting or claims decisions.
caps: A renewal pack is ready for broker review.

cards.t: Please confirm your current staff numbers for the renewal.
